stage1.impression: A moody pine wood with real depth and convincing shafts of light, but the whole frame is one sepia-orange wash: the smoke reads as dust or a sandstorm rather than woodsmoke, and the burn pile is a dull orange blob with dot-like embers. The speaker sits plausibly in the air but its lower two thirds dissolve into the dark ground, the tinted acrylic and lining barely read, and the denoised trunks look waxy. Atmospheric, competent, still reads as CG.

blocking_9: Smoke must read as blue-grey woodsmoke against warm dawn light, not an orange haze: plume region 560,100,820,420 b_median >= 70 (now 39)
Speaker body must separate from the ground and show its tint, lining and woofer: body 340,380,530,600 lum_median 45-60 (now 31) with a visible rim on both verticals
The burn pile must read as a fire at a glance: a lit glow on the logs, the ground and the plume's underside, not isolated ember dots
Surfaces need photographic micro-detail: bark on the foreground trunks and litter on the ground, not denoiser-smoothed wax
A real tonal range: highlights in the light shafts and the fire, frame lum_p95 >= 160

defects.what: Monochrome sepia grade; sky, smoke, ground and speaker all share one orange-brown hue, no cool counterpoint
Burn-pile plume is orange (RGB 105,64,37, dE2000 54 vs its specified #E4E2DE) and does not read as a distinct rising column
Fire is box-like logs with round ember dots; no flame, no glow on the surrounding ground, reads as a placeholder
Speaker body lum_median 32 against ground 29; lower half merges with the ground, the white lining and woofer are barely visible through the tint
Left vertical edge of the speaker has almost no separation (edge step 21)
Foreground trunk is a smooth waxy column with no bark detail; denoiser smearing
Foreground ground is flat and muddy (lum_range 21), soft texture, little litter or needle detail
Flat tonal range: p1 21, p99 156, no highlight anywhere; the shafts lack punch

changes.problem: Everything is orange: the warm sun scattering through dense volumes turns all smoke into dust, killing the 'woodsmoke' read.

evidence.measured: RGB median 117,70,39; dE2000 54 vs plume colour #E4E2DE; background 200,200,320,500 RGB 146,102,61

change.setting: Sun lamp colour / uniform haze colour / Sky strength
change.to: sun #FFCC9A, haze #C4CAD2 (cool blue-grey), sky 0.35 so the ambient in the shadowed smoke goes cool

changes.expected: Smoke in shadow turns blue-grey, sunlit shafts stay warm: a warm/cool split that reads as dawn woodsmoke. Plume b_median rises to about 75-95.

changes.problem: The speaker's body is as dark as the ground, so its silhouette, tint, lining and woofer are lost.

evidence.measured: lum_median 31.3 vs ground 0,650,1200,800 lum_median 29.0; left edge step 21

change.setting: Speaker lights: bounce, sky fill, kickers
change.to: bounce 14.0 (from low front-left, #C9BBA8), sky fill 4.0, kickers 55 / 45 with the weaker one moved to rim the left vertical

changes.expected: Body lum_median about 50; the lining and woofer read through the tint; both verticals carry a thin warm rim.

changes.problem: The burn pile does not read as a fire: dot embers, no glow on the logs or ground, plume not a column.

evidence.measured: fire base lum_p95 98.5; plume 560,360,760,440 lum_median 91 barely above surrounding haze

change.setting: Burn pile: ember point light, ember glow, plume
change.from: 80 W point light, ember dots, plume density 3.5 falling 0.85/cell
change.to: 250 W point light 0.3 m above the embers plus a 1 m area glow under the logs (#FF7A30); embers as glowing crevices along the logs; plume density 5.0 falling 0.8/cell with its cool fill raised to 8.0 so the column reads pale against the darker trunks

changes.expected: A warm pool of light on the ground around the pile, a pale smoke column rising and drifting left, the fire legible at thumbnail size.

changes.problem: The image is flat with no highlight; the god rays have no punch.

evidence.measured: summary p1 21.3, p50 63.6, p99 156.2, no clipping

change.to: AgX Medium High Contrast, exposure +0.3, contrast 0.10, sun irradiance 30 -> 40

changes.expected: Shafts reach lum ~200, deep shadows stay ~20, overall p95 around 165.

changes.problem: The foreground ground is a flat, soft brown with no readable litter.

change.to: add a pine-needle and cone scatter (several hundred cones/needles clumps), 15-20 branches, low moss patches; let one canopy dapple land in the foreground

changes.expected: Foreground shows sharp-ish litter detail and a sunlit dapple, range about 35.

changes.problem: Trunks and fine textures are smoothed to wax by the denoiser at 128 samples and half size.

evidence.measured: crop at 2x shows no bark texture on the nearest trunk, smooth gradients only

change.to: 2400 x 1600, 1024 samples, OIDN with albedo+normal passes (prefilter accurate); pine_bark texture scale up so plates are visible at 4 m

changes.expected: Bark plates and needle litter hold detail; no waxy smears.

changes.problem: The speaker sits low-left in a large empty field of uniform ground; the top third of haze is the only room for type and the fire competes on the right third.

evidence.measured: bottom 22% of frame is near-uniform dark ground, lum_median 29

change.to: 0.55 m height, 6.0 m, 75 mm, same azimuth; keep the fire on the right third behind the speaker

changes.expected: Speaker larger in frame (about 55% of height), less dead ground, more compressed trunks behind; top band kept clear for type.

out_of_scope.request: The horn's top reflects a large dark distorted shape that reads as a blob at thumbnail size
out_of_scope.why: It is the speaker's own surface and geometry; can only be softened by the environment it reflects, not changed
